cc:Work.dc:title: SYNDROME | Confidence, retained coverage and mistakes
cc:Work.dc:description: Confidence = max(P(flip), 1−P(flip)); distinct from event probability. A: overlapping fixed post-hoc cutoffs; labels show the cutoff. B: disjoint confidence bins [0.5,0.6), …, [0.9,1]; labels show counts. Bars are pointwise 95% Wilson intervals, conditional on this model; no simultaneous band or threshold recommendation. Lines guide the eye between saved diagnostic summaries. No model fitting, recalibration, or new evidence here. Data: d3-memory-z-20261115T004549Z-confirmation-20261115T011610Z Analysis: d3-memory-z-20261115T004549Z-diagnostics-20261115T015124Z
